description: Open a copy of r-sort-3-corpus-accdb (ACCDB) read-write. SELECT * INTO TB FROM T; DELETE FROM T; INSERT INTO T SELECT * FROM TB ORDER BY ID DESC (reverse insertion into the emptied indexes); UPDATE T to set K = 'x' for every third ID, and then back to TB.K through an INNER JOIN. Whole-file images are kept after each step. Reads the IX_K and IX_KD traversal and SQL ORDER BY K of T after the reinsert and after the update back. Asks the order and tie order of incrementally maintained keys, and the file images of delete, reinsert and in-place key change (compare with the fresh build of the fixture).
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.

Whole-file images are kept after each step. Reads the IX_K and IX_KD traversal and SQL ORDER BY K of T after the reinsert and after the update back. args.text: INSERT INTO T (ID, K, G) SELECT ID, K, G FROM TB ORDER BY ID DESC
SELECT ID FROM T ORDER BY K
UPDATE T SET K = 'x' WHERE ID MOD 3 = 0
UPDATE T INNER JOIN TB ON T.ID = TB.ID SET T.K = TB.K WHERE T.ID MOD 3 = 0
SELECT ID FROM T ORDER BY K
